about: Unit cases for decompose(amount, eligible, options): eligible is sorted high to low. Option callbacks are given as tables. credit(j) = credit[j], or 0 past the end. bonus(v) and pop(v) = the table entry for that value, or 0. changeVb and creditChange are either a single number or {upTo, then, else}: the "then" value for a remainder up to "upTo" satoshis, the "else" value above it; creditChange null means the option is absent. exclude is a set of values; null means absent. expected null means no plan exists.
